trusted_root_hashing: SHA256(canonical JSON payload; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=comma-colon)
variant_rule: Apply only the preregistered mutations/removals. Root records and unrelated obligation bytes remain unchanged.

control_projection.defer: all due=false/can_defer=true statements plus explicit KEEP OPEN language
control_projection.open_touch: represented only as unresolved partial-payoff pressure; never supplied as resolved fact

treatment_projection: Expand compact rows; inject validated root evidence from frozen root_records; group by obligation kind; execute Adaptive broadcast_mode=true.
spacetime_rule: Earliest-feasible deterministic schedule in generated scene order; 2-minute scene; frozen transition cost; inherited obligation time/location.
